To install quickshell-git on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add quickshell-git. It is a 70.7 MB download (207.1 MB installed), version 0.3.2.r0.g4f508be-5, licensed LGPL-3.0-only. Flexible toolkit for making desktop shells with QtQuick. Free and open source.

Install quickshell-git on Omarchy

Quickshell is a flexible, code-first toolkit for building custom desktop shell components — status bars, widgets, lock screens, notification centers and more — using QtQuick/QML, primarily for Wayland compositors such as Hyprland (with X11 support too). Rather than a ready-made shell, it's a low-level building-block library with hot reloading that developers use to assemble their own desktop UI, so it powers other people's Hyprland setups rather than offering one out of the box.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add quickshell-git
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.3.2.r0.g4f508be-5:
    pacman -Qi quickshell-git

Open and use quickshell-git

quickshell-git has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql quickshell-git | grep /usr/bin/

quickshell-git requirements and compatibility

  • Qt development libraries and a C++ toolchain to build from source
  • Programming in QML/C++ to actually build a shell with it — it is not a ready-made desktop UI

Frequently asked questions

How do I install quickshell-git on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add quickshell-git. The download is 70.7 MB and it takes 207.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is quickshell-git free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed LGPL-3.0-only.

How do I uninstall quickshell-git?

Run omarchy pkg drop quickshell-git. It removes the package from your system.

What does quickshell-git depend on?

The package declares 12 dependencies: qt6-declarative, qt6-base, jemalloc, qt6-svg, libpipewire, libxcb, wayland, libdrm, mesa, cpptrace, vulkan-headers, polkit. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is quickshell-git a desktop app?

No. quickshell-git has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is quickshell-git in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as quickshell-git (version 0.3.2.r0.g4f508be-5) in the official Omarchy package repository. Outfoxxed makes it. Project site: https://git.outfoxxed.me/quickshell/quickshell.
